test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I want to enrol myself for this management __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**course**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Course"** is a noun which means *a series of lessons or study guide.*Example : I want to take a German** course.**
 
• There is an another meaning of word**"course"**i.e.,*a path or direction taken by any traveler or mode of transportation.*Examples: Napoleon directed the **course** of battle. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **"cause"** is a noun which also have two meanings

 * Reason for feeling or behaving in a particular way*, Ex - The cops have no idea what **caused** the accident.

 * Something or someone who cause something to happen.* Ex - The doctor assured us there was no **cause **of concern.

 
• The word **"caws" **is a noun which means a *hard , rough sound created by a crow. *Ex - The crows are **cawing** very loudly today.
 
• The word** "coarse"** is an adjective which means *made up of large pieces; rough; not smooth*. Ex - This dal contains very **coarse** grains.
